title: TranslateContractTitle
description: Machine translations of a contract's title, emitted by the translation service. Keyed by contract_key, and scoped to the notice whose title was translated: a sink applies it to the :Contract only while that notice is still the contract's canonical one (the contract shows its latest notice's title), and never creates the contract. A modification that keeps the title does not produce a new one. Carries the source title so sinks need no prior state.

contract_key.description: The contract the title belongs to — UpsertContract.contract_key.

ted_notice_id.description: The notice whose title this is — UpsertContract.ted_notice_id.

title.description: The source title that was translated. The sink records it as title_translated_from, so a later change of title is seen as one.

source_lang.description: ISO 639-1 code of the title's language, or 'und' when the model identified it while translating.

source_lang_origin.description: Where source_lang came from: 'stated' by the source (the notice's title_lang, Kohesio's English-name column), 'detected' from the title's words by a model (see detected_by), or 'unknown'. A sink records a detected language as title_lang_detected, never as title_lang, which only a source states.

detected_by.description: The model that detected source_lang, when source_lang_origin is 'detected' (e.g. 'nebius:google/gemma-3-27b-it').

translations.description: ISO 639-1 language code -> translated title. EU official languages only; never the source language.

method.description: Translation provenance, e.g. 'nebius:google/gemma-3-27b-it', or 'backfill:neo4j' for a translation re-published from the graph.
